description: This PHP class 'LeavePeriodDefinedHomePageEnabler' is part of the OrangeHRM system. It implements an interface to determine if the 'leave period' feature has been defined for a user; if not, it enables directing the user to define it. The class utilizes a trait to access the leave configuration service and provides a method to check if the leave period is already set.
